description: This PHP class, ProviderMigrationService, handles the creation and management of OAuth providers for Google Calendar synchronization within SuiteCRM. It includes methods for validation, creating or retrieving OAuth provider records, and specific logic related to Google OAuth configuration.

classes.name: ProviderMigrationService
classes.description: Handles migration tasks for OAuth providers related to calendar sync in SuiteCRM, especially creating and validating Google OAuth providers based on configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes database and logger dependencies; throws exceptions if dependencies are not available.

methods.name: validateProviderRequirements
methods.description: Checks if the ExternalOAuthProvider module exists and the relevant database table exists, returning issues if any.

methods.name: createOrGetExternalOAuthProvider
methods.description: Creates a new Google OAuth provider record based on configuration if one does not already exist, or retrieves an existing one.

methods.name: findExistingGoogleOAuthProvider
methods.description: Searches for an existing OAuth provider record linked to Google Calendar scope.
